content.title: 'Dune: Part 3' Tickets Are On Sale — Here's How To Find An IMAX 70MM Screening Near You
content.text: Film & TVWith just eight months until the film's release, fan excitement is already ramping up.Timothée Chalamet at a premiere of 'Dune: Part 2' in Mexico. Getty Images.Later this year, the Dune saga is coming to an epic end with the release of Dune: Part 3 in December 2026. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, each film in the series thus far has brought plenty of drama, political intrigue, sci-fi worldbuilding, and spectacular special effects, and Dune: Part 3 promises to wrap up Paul Atreides' story with finesse. For cinephiles across the world, the modern reboot of the iconic sci-fi franchise has been one of the most alluring movie projects in recent decades. As a unit, Villeneuve's first two Dune movies have generated $1 billion worldwide, per Variety, illustrating the massive, widespread interest in the series. Featuring Timothée Chalamet, Robert Pattinson, Zendaya, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, and Anya Taylor-Joy, among others, the film is star-studded, making it a must-watch for pop culture obsessives and sci-fi lovers alike. Curious to see if a Dune: Part 3 special screening is coming to a theatre near you? Join L'OFFICIEL as we break down the details on the buzzy cinematic experience.Dune: Part 3 Tickets: How to Buy IMAX 70mm Screening Tickets?Tickets to Dune: Part 3 70mm IMAX screening are available to shop on the IMAX website. If your local theatre is participating in the special screening, visit your location's website.
